name: Tacoma Narrows Bridge
description: Suspension bridge collapse caused by aeroelastic flutter under 42mph winds.
lessons_learned: Bridges must be tested for aerodynamic stability; simple structural strength is not enough.

name: Chernobyl Disaster
description: RBMK reactor explosion during a poorly managed safety test.
lessons_learned: Safety systems must never be overridden; positive void coefficient designs are inherently dangerous.

name: Boeing 737 MAX MCAS
description: MCAS system repeatedly pushed nose down due to single sensor failure.
lessons_learned: Redundant sensors are mandatory for flight-critical software; automated systems must have manual overrides.

name: Deepwater Horizon
description: Oil well blowout leading to the largest marine oil spill in history.
lessons_learned: Blowout preventers must be regularly tested; speed should never prioritize safety in drilling.
